import MumfordLib.SingularAffineSimplex
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.Convex

/-!
# Diameter bounds for affine singular simplices

Affine parametrizations lie in the convex hull of their vertices. Their
diameter is therefore bounded by pairwise vertex distances. The barycenter
has the vertex-radius bound used for barycentric subdivision.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {I J K : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype K]

/-- An affine simplex lies in the convex hull of its vertices. -/
theorem affineSimplexMap_mem_convexHull (v : I → stdSimplex ℝ J)
    (t : stdSimplex ℝ I) :
    (affineSimplexMap v t).val ∈ convexHull ℝ (Set.range fun i => (v i).val) := by
  exact (convex_convexHull ℝ _).sum_mem (fun i _ => stdSimplex.zero_le t i)
    (stdSimplex.sum_eq_one t) (fun i _ => subset_convexHull ℝ _ (Set.mem_range_self i))

/-- Pairwise vertex bounds control every distance in the affine image. -/
theorem affineSimplexMap_dist_le (v : I → stdSimplex ℝ J) {D : ℝ}
    (hD : ∀ i j, dist (v i) (v j) ≤ D) (s t : stdSimplex ℝ I) :
    dist (affineSimplexMap v s) (affineSimplexMap v t) ≤ D := by
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, _, ⟨j, rfl⟩, h⟩ :=
    convexHull_exists_dist_ge2 (affineSimplexMap_mem_convexHull v s)
      (affineSimplexMap_mem_convexHull v t)
  exact h.trans (hD i j)

/-- Pairwise vertex bounds control the image diameter, including empty images. -/
theorem affineSimplexMap_diam_le (v : I → stdSimplex ℝ J) {D : ℝ}
    (hD₀ : 0 ≤ D) (hD : ∀ i j, dist (v i) (v j) ≤ D) :
    Metric.diam (Set.range (affineSimplexMap v)) ≤ D := by
  apply Metric.diam_le_of_forall_dist_le hD₀
  rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩ _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
  exact affineSimplexMap_dist_le v hD s t

/-- The barycenter of a nonempty vertex list, with repetitions counted. -/
def affineSimplexBarycenter [Nonempty I] (v : I → stdSimplex ℝ J) : stdSimplex ℝ J :=
  affineSimplexMap v stdSimplex.barycenter

/-! Affine maps are compatible with composition of vertex lists. -/

theorem affineSimplexMap_comp (v : I → stdSimplex ℝ J) (w : J → stdSimplex ℝ K)
    (t : stdSimplex ℝ I) :
    affineSimplexMap w (affineSimplexMap v t) =
      affineSimplexMap (fun i => affineSimplexMap w (v i)) t := by
  ext k
  simp only [affineSimplexMap_apply]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [mul_assoc]

theorem affineSimplexMap_vertex_id [DecidableEq I] (t : stdSimplex ℝ I) :
    affineSimplexMap (stdSimplex.vertex : I → stdSimplex ℝ I) t = t := by
  ext i
  simp [affineSimplexMap_apply, Pi.single_apply]

theorem affineSimplexBarycenter_map [Nonempty I]
    (v : I → stdSimplex ℝ J) (w : J → stdSimplex ℝ K) :
    affineSimplexMap w (affineSimplexBarycenter v) =
      affineSimplexBarycenter (fun i => affineSimplexMap w (v i)) := by
  change affineSimplexMap w (affineSimplexMap v stdSimplex.barycenter) =
    affineSimplexMap (fun i => affineSimplexMap w (v i)) stdSimplex.barycenter
  exact affineSimplexMap_comp v w stdSimplex.barycenter

/-- The barycenter is within the vertex diameter of every vertex. -/
theorem affineSimplexBarycenter_dist_le [Nonempty I]
    (v : I → stdSimplex ℝ J) {D : ℝ}
    (hD : ∀ i j, dist (v i) (v j) ≤ D) (i : I) :
    dist (affineSimplexBarycenter v) (v i) ≤ D := by
  classical
  rw [affineSimplexBarycenter, ← affineSimplexMap_vertex v i]
  exact affineSimplexMap_dist_le v hD stdSimplex.barycenter (stdSimplex.vertex i)

@[simp]
theorem affineSimplexBarycenter_apply [Nonempty I] (v : I → stdSimplex ℝ J) (j : J) :
    affineSimplexBarycenter v j = (Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, v i j := by
  rw [affineSimplexBarycenter, affineSimplexMap_apply]
  change ∑ i, (stdSimplex.barycenter : stdSimplex ℝ I) i * v i j = _
  change ∑ i, (Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹ * v i j = _
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]

end Mumford.Analytic
